notes.title: Demo is released!
notes.content:
Guten Tag, dear players. This is Neruthes from Nekostein, the 2-man team behind this game. I am happy to announce that we have released the demo today.

We are doing Steam key giveaway this month, and hope to reward players who help making this game known to more people.

Join our Discord server to help deciding the development roadmap of this game.



[h2]Play the Demo to Earn a Key[/h2]
You may earn a Steam key for the full game if you:
[list]    [*]Play the demo;[/*]    [*]Capture gameplay video for at least 30 seconds;[/*]    [*]Upload video to YouTube, Twitch, TikTok or any other legit social media (viewable without an account);[/*]    [*]Indicate your Steam profile in the video or the description;[/*]    [*]Share the link to your video on our Discord server in the [b]#random[/b] channel and mention [b]@admin[/b];[/*]    [*]Come early enough (phase 1 for 25 keys) or become lucky enough (phase 2 for another 25 keys by the end of October 2024).[/*][/list]
And these limits apply:
[list]    [*]Total quantity is limited to 50, or less than that, depending on how many keys Steam approves to generate;[/*]    [*]Your video must earn at least 10 views or 10 likes/favorites;[/*]    [*]Link to your video must be posted in Discord before 2024-10-27 23 : 59 : 59 UTC;[/*]    [*]Your Discord profile must be link to the indicated Steam profile;[/*]    [*]Each Steam profile, social media profile, and Discord profile may only claim once.[/*][/list]
And finally, one exception applies:
[list]    [*]If your video goes particularly popular (10000+ views or 1000+ likes/favorites), we will give you one anyway regardless of anything. This is not included in the quota of 50.[/*][/list]
